answer: The glacier holds work receipts rather than names, so the terrace of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Reaching the onyx of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
